summary: Russian forces launched a large-scale drone attack across Ukraine with over 30 Shahed/Geran-5 and reactive UAVs targeting Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, and other regions, striking a shopping center in Vyshneve. Ukrainian air defenses engaged multiple groups launched from Kursk, Shatalovo, Orel, Millerovo, and Gvardeyskoye. Meanwhile, Russian troops advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk Oblast.
key_points: Russian drones struck TC "Novus" in Vyshneve, Kyiv Oblast, with casualties reported and rescue operations underway (Source: @eRadarrua/132676).
Over 30 Shahed/Geran-5 and reactive UAVs launched from Kursk (11 groups), Shatalovo (2), Orel (3), Millerovo (2), Gvardeyskoye (2) targeting central and northern Ukraine (Source: @eRadarrua/132679).
Kyiv air raid alert lasted from 15:33 to 18:37 with multiple Geran-5 impacts in Vyshhorod, Vyshneve, Chabany areas (Source: @eRadarrua/132630).
Russian forces advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk Oblast per DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018).
Slovakia refuses to join new €45B EU loan for Ukraine; PM Fico calls it a "gift" Ukraine cannot repay (Source: @UkraineNow/85457).
Czech PM Babiš threatens to block €100B EU aid package for Ukraine over budget disagreements (Source: @UkraineNow/85461).
UK and Ukraine signed agreement for joint production of middle/deep strike drones financed by Britain (Source: @UkraineNow/85454).
Explosions reported at Baltiysk naval base in Kaliningrad Oblast with video showing red sky and smoke (Source: @UkraineNow/85449).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched a massive coordinated drone wave from five Russian airfields targeting Kyiv and central Ukraine, hitting a shopping center in Vyshneve with casualties. Simultaneously, Russian ground forces advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk Oblast. Political tensions rose as Slovakia and Czechia threatened to block major EU financial aid packages for Ukraine.

points: Ukrainian air defenses engaged over 30 Shahed/Geran-5 and reactive UAVs across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Kharkiv, Sumy, and Rivne oblasts throughout the afternoon (Source: @eRadarrua/132623).
Rescue workers recovered a body from rubble of a destroyed five-story building in Dymyr, Kyiv Oblast, following earlier strikes (Source: @UkraineNow/85460).
Kyiv Oblast air raid alert activated at 15:33 and lifted at 18:37 after multiple Geran-5 impacts in Vyshhorod, Vyshneve, and Chabany districts (Source: @eRadarrua/132630).
Ukraine and UK signed defense cooperation agreement for joint production of middle-strike and deep-strike drones with British financing for Ukrainian forces (Source: @UkraineNow/85454).
Local media and subscribers reported strike on TC "Novus" shopping center in Vyshneve with people fleeing the building; official confirmation awaited (Source: @eRadarrua/132668).

Russian forces launched drone waves from five locations: Kursk (11 groups total), Shatalovo (2 groups), Orel (3 groups), Millerovo (2 groups), and Gvardeyskoye (2 groups) using Shahed/Geran-5 and reactive UAV types (Source: @eRadarrua/132679).
Geran-5 drones specifically targeted Kyiv/Vyshhorod (3 from Chernihiv), Kyiv/Vyshneve (1 from Zhytomyr), and Kyiv/Obukhiv (1 from Cherkasy) per monitoring channels (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78725).
Russian ground forces advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk Oblast according to DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018).

Reactive UAV groups tracked moving from Chernihiv Oblast (5 groups past Slavutych), Poltava Oblast (6 groups past Novi Sanzhary and Hlobyne), and Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (4 groups) toward central Ukraine (Source: @eRadarrua/132626).
Explosions and red sky observed at Baltiysk naval base in Kaliningrad Oblast, home of Russia's Baltic Fleet, with unverified video circulating (Source: @UkraineNow/85449).
Russian troops advanced near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka in Donetsk Oblast per latest DeepState map revision (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018).
Kharkiv Oblast recorded 1 "Bandero" UAV and 5 reactive UAV groups operating in the region during the drone wave (Source: @eRadarrua/132638).
Zaporizhzhia Oblast reported 2 strike UAV groups active in the area (Source: @eRadarrua/132623).
Dnipropetrovsk Oblast tracked 4 reactive UAV groups earlier and 1 group later moving toward Kirovohrad Oblast (Source: @eRadarrua/132623).
No specific ground combat reports from Bakhmut, Avdiivka, or Kupiansk sectors in current messages.
Chernihiv Oblast served as major launch corridor with 5 reactive UAV groups past Slavutych, 1 group past Desna, and 1 group past Snivsk moving south toward Kyiv (Source: @eRadarrua/132626).
Sumy Oblast recorded 1 reactive UAV group active during the wave (Source: @eRadarrua/132638).
Kursk airfield launched 11 total Shahed groups (5 initially, 6 later) toward northern and central Ukraine (Source: @eRadarrua/132679).
Shatalovo airfield (Smolensk Oblast) launched 2 groups of presumed reactive UAVs (Source: @eRadarrua/132681).
Zhytomyr Oblast tracked 4 reactive UAV groups moving west along state border and 3 past Ovruch, 2 toward Korosten likely continuing to Rivne Oblast (Source: @eRadarrua/132635).
Mykolaiv Oblast reported 1 reactive UAV group moving toward Kirovohrad Oblast past Vradiivka (Source: @kpszsu/98504).
Odesa Oblast recorded 1 strike UAV group active (Source: @eRadarrua/132624).
Gvardeyskoye airfield (Crimea) launched 2 groups of presumed reactive UAVs (Source: @eRadarrua/132651).
Kherson Oblast not specifically mentioned in current drone tracking messages.
No ground combat updates from Zaporizhzhia or Kherson directions in provided messages.
Massive multi-axis drone attack: 11 groups from Kursk, 2 from Shatalovo, 3 from Orel, 2 from Millerovo, 2 from Gvardeyskoye — mix of Shahed/Geran-5 and reactive UAVs (Source: @eRadarrua/132679).

Kyiv Oblast saturated: Geran-5 on Vyshhorod (3), Vyshneve (1), Chabany (1); reactive UAVs on Boryspil (2), Brovary, Vasylkiv, Fastiv, Voronkiv, Pereiaslav, Kaharlyk, Ivanivka, Tetiyiv, Chabany (Source: @eRadarrua/132636).
Cherkasy Oblast targeted by 3 reactive UAVs from Poltava (Zolotonosha), 2 groups on Cherkasy city, 1 from Mykolaiv (Haisyn), 1 from Cherkasy to Kyiv/Obukhiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78725).
Vinnytsia Oblast tracked: 1 reactive UAV on Koziatyn, 1 past Pohrebyshche westbound, 1 past Dashiv northwest, 1 on Illintsi, 1 on Pohrebyshche (Source: @kpszsu/98516).
Rivne Oblast: 3 UAVs on Sarny, 1 on Berezne from Zhytomyr direction (Source: @eRadarrua/132643).
Dnipro and Kamianske each had 1 reactive UAV inbound; Kirovohrad Oblast had 1 on Oleksandriia from Dnipropetrovsk (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78725).
Altitude 4000m and speed 555 km/h recorded for Geran-5 over Vyshhorod heading to Troieshchyna (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78723).

key_developments: Russian drone wave from 5 airfields hit Kyiv Oblast shopping center in Vyshneve with casualties; rescue ongoing (Source: @eRadarrua/132676).
Geran-5 strikes confirmed in Vyshhorod, Vyshneve, Chabany; Kyiv air alert 3 hours (Source: @eRadarrua/132630).
Russian ground advance near Novomarkove and Mykolaivka, Donetsk Oblast (Source: @DeepStateUA/24018).
Slovakia rejects €45B EU loan for Ukraine; Fico calls it unpayable gift (Source: @UkraineNow/85457).
Czechia threatens to block €100B EU aid package over budget disputes (Source: @UkraineNow/85461).
UK-Ukraine deal for British-funded joint drone production signed (Source: @UkraineNow/85454).
Explosions at Baltiysk naval base in Kaliningrad; unverified videos show heavy smoke (Source: @UkraineNow/85449).
sections.threat_assessment: Russia demonstrated capacity for large-scale coordinated drone saturation attacks from multiple airfields simultaneously, overwhelming air defense coverage across central and northern Ukraine. The use of both Shahed/Geran-5 and faster reactive UAVs complicates interception. Ground advances near Novomarkove/Mykolaivka suggest continued pressure on Donetsk front. Political fragmentation in EU aid (Slovakia, Czechia) threatens long-term Ukrainian sustainment. Baltiysk explosions indicate possible Ukrainian strike capability deep in Russian territory.
sections.regional_response: Slovakia's Fico explicitly rejects new EU macro-financial assistance for Ukraine, linking it to budget negotiations and questioning Ukraine's repayment capacity. Czech PM Babiš threatens veto on €100B EU support package. Conversely, UK deepens defense industrial cooperation with Ukraine via joint drone production. NATO Secretary General Rutte reaffirmed Article 5 commitment to Poland after Russian missile airspace violations. Visegrád Four plus Austria meeting Monday will test regional unity on Ukraine support.
sections.intelligence_notes: Drone launch pattern shows diversification: Kursk (primary), Shatalovo (strategic bombers base), Orel, Millerovo, Gvardeyskoye (Crimea) — indicating full western military district involvement. Reactive UAVs flying at 4000m/555 km/h suggest improved performance. Targeting of commercial infrastructure (TC Novus) marks shift to economic terror. DeepState map updates confirm incremental Russian gains in Donetsk sector. Baltiysk incident, if confirmed, would represent significant Ukrainian reach to Baltic Fleet headquarters.
